corrections.why: smith-peak.html is the Smith Peak in Tuolumne County (Stanislaus National Forest), a different tower; the Plumas lookout's history is on smith-peak1.html

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two Smith Peak lookouts exist: this Plumas tower and a Tuolumne/Mariposa tower in the Stanislaus National Forest. Newspaper items in the smith-peak.html page refer to the Tuolumne tower, which burned in 1987.

notes_for_editor: Record source_pages includes smith-peak.html, which is the Tuolumne Smith Peak; proposed correction above. The register says the cabin sits on a '9 foot enclosed timber tower', which is unclear and was not used in the story. Current staffing ('staffed as_of 2020') rests on the register; the Sierra REC article has no date in the cached text. Pages about Smith Peak near Groveland (the 2024 Roaming Civic post and a 1931 'administrative site' claim in a search snippet) concern the Tuolumne tower and were not used. No fire events attributable to this tower were found in the newspaper items read.
